ruleDefinitions.name: Time Machine Backup Disabled Via Tmutil - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects disabling of Time Machine (Apple's automated backup utility software) via the native macOS backup utility "tmutil".
An attacker can use this to prevent backups from occurring.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/tmutil$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*tmutil.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*disable.*"))
